## Xyllostrap v1.0.1 🐱

### Download
Download **Xyllostrap.exe** below and run it. You don't need to install .NET.
If Windows SmartScreen pops up, click **More info → Run anyway** (the exe isn't code-signed yet).

### Changes
- The installer now lists **github.com/06Xyllo/Xyllostrap** as the only official download
- Removed the Discord server links from the launch menu and About page
- Tray icon: right-click → **Exit Xyllostrap** always works
- Xyllostrap now closes itself when Roblox closes
- "GitHub repository" and "Report issue" links now go to this repo

### Features
- **FastFlag templates**: 🍕 Potato Graphics · 🎯 Rivals · 🏆 Competitive / No Clutter · ✨ Max Quality, or save your own
- A purple theme with smooth animations and a cat logo

Built on Fishstrap and Bloxstrap.
